name: human-org-buying
notes: H3: vanilla PurchaseOrgs breaks at the first conflicting candidate (~1 org per weekly pass). With the fix, extra passes buy past conflicts. Compare org counts with the vanilla run. First run (2026-10-18): 64 extra orgs bought by re-run passes in 120 days, but AI org totals at the end matched vanilla (355 vs 353): the extra orgs are shed again, so the fix churns money. FixOrgBuying stays OFF pending investigation.
